title: Renew your Working with Children Check
summary: Learn about the two ways to renew your Working with Children Check (WWCC) and what you need for each method.
intro:
There are 2 ways to renew your Working with Children Check (WWCC), depending on how you choose to have your identification verified:

You cannot renew online using face verification if:

### Fee payment

To renew your WWCC costs $107 for paid workers and is free for volunteers.

### When to renew

Your WWCC expires after 5 years.

You'll be notified by email 3 months before its expiry date. You can renew your WWCC from this time.

### Access your WWCC details

The Working with Children Check (WWCC) is an online system and does not have a physical card or certificate. Find out how to access your WWCC details.
who_can_apply: The WWCC is required for paid workers and volunteers.
You can renew your WWCC online using face verification or at a service centre.
what_you_need: For online renewal using face verification: A MyServiceNSW Account with the 'Working with Children Check' service added, 3 current identity documents, a device with a working front camera, and a credit or debit card, PayPal, or PayID (if payment is required).
For renewal at a service centre: Your WWCC number, 4 identity documents, the email showing your APP number, your original identity documents, and your payment (if applicable).

more_info.text: For information about the renewal and WWCC screening processes, visit the OCG website.
Remember to keep your WWCC details up to date so you can be contacted.
Learn more about using face verification to confirm your identity online.
